events.outcome: Legacy Rp5,000/year keep-cost inference is unsupported by current rules. Rp5,000 top-up is not documented as a 365-day extension; official extension options include Rp115,000/360 days, while qualifying usage/top-up/package rules may yield cheaper paths whose durable annual minimum remains unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: SIMPATI is an Indonesian prepaid mobile line. Current Telkomsel terms say SIM activation is performed in Indonesia. Exact current starter-kit price is not reconciled in this review.

keep.action: Current official mechanisms include credit top-up, qualifying credit usage/package purchase and Active Period Extension packages. The dedicated extension menu currently lists 360 days at Rp115,000. A qualifying minimum Rp1 usage can extend 30 days under stated conditions, so do not label Rp115,000 as the theoretical minimum; exact lowest durable annual path remains unresolved.

data.chinaActivation: New SIM activation is documented as occurring in Indonesia. Do not assume first activation from China or another foreign country.
data.kyc: Activation/identity requirements follow Indonesian telecom rules; this review does not reduce them to a simple passport-only claim.
data.payment: Local/app top-up channels exist; international-card acceptance is not reconciled.
data.roamingSms: Not used for admission. Current long-term overseas continuity is constrained by Telkomsel rule that 90 consecutive days without connection can trigger the lifecycle/grace process.
data.holdReason: Exact cheapest durable annual retention path is unresolved; activation is Indonesia-local and the current 90-day no-network-connection rule creates overseas continuity risk.
data.tariffSummary: Multiple official active-period mechanisms; 360-day extension Rp115,000 is documented, but the true minimum annual keep cost is unresolved.
guideSteps: Activate in Indonesia under current identity/device rules.
Use a current official active-period mechanism before expiry.
Do not rely on the stale Rp5,000/year estimate or assume an overseas-only line can remain disconnected from Telkomsel indefinitely.
